description.text: Thousands of international students from over 100 countries choose to study at Donghua University (DHU) each year. International Cultural Exchange School (ICES) offers diverse Chinese programs suitable for different time schedules and demands.

duration.text: The Comprehensive Chinese Project at Donghua University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1500 USD/per semester ￥ 10800 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Copy of visa Only for students who have already be in China

requirements.text: The applicant should be a non-Chinese citizen in good health, between 16 and 60 years old and should hold a valid foreign passport. (If you are currently in China, you need to hold a valid Chinese visa as well.)
